edition.title: AI Design Daily
edition.headline: Open image models had the week, and agents learned to drive Blender
edition.summary: FLUX 3 Klein, Krea 3 and MOSS-Image all landed within about 24 hours, Kling 4.0 went global, and the most-bookmarked creative technique of the week was Claude Opus 5.5 building 3D models through Blender MCP. 87 verified items from Oct 10–17.

items.title: Blender blockout → Seedance 2.5 horror short (ComfyUI)
items.note: you build a rough 3D blockout in Blender to set the camera, action, and timing, then Seedance 2.5 renders the final video. That gives you real directing control instead of hoping a prompt lands. Start: grab the workflow and prompt from the link in the post, and block out a 3-shot scene with plain cubes.

items.title: Make game models with Claude Opus 5.5 + Blender MCP
items.note: Opus writes Python and builds each model part by part in Blender. "Treat every model as code." Start: install mcp-for-blender (uvx mcp-for-blender@latest), connect it to Claude, and ask for one prop.

items.title: Turn any repo into a 45-second explainer video (HyperFrames + diagram-design)
items.note: these are two of this week's fastest-growing GitHub repos, chained inside Claude Code. Start: claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes, then claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes, then npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design, then paste the prompt from the post.

items.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein announcement (BFL)
items.note: A 5.6B open-weights model released Oct 15: native 4K, editing with up to 10 references, bounding-box layout control, and a build that runs on 8 GB of VRAM. Free commercial use under $5M revenue.
